scripts.allure:report: npx playwright test --reporter=line,allure-playwright && npx allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report && npx allure open allure-report
scripts.allure:report:ci: npx playwright test --reporter=line,allure-playwright && npx allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report
scripts.clean: npx rimraf allure-results allure-report playwright-report test-results
scripts.logger: node -e "const winston=require('winston'); const logger=winston.createLogger({ level:'info', transports:[new winston.transports.Console()] }); logger.info('Winston logger is ready');"
